newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish 1996 GDP data better than expected - analysts.
newsitem.headline: Danish 1996 GDP data better than expected - analysts.

text.p: Analysts greeted Denmark's 1996 GDP data released on Wednesday as indicating better, broader based and more evenly balanced economic growth than expected.

"Denmark's economic upturn looks like continuing with undiminished strength. The data points to a more balanced growth, with exports making a greater contribution," Unibank Markets economist Jesper Nielsen told Reuters.

Earlier the national statistics office released data showing Denmark's GDP grew by 2.4 percent in 1996 compared to 2.6 per cent in the previous year, but rose 3.3 percent in the fourth quarter from the same 1995 period.
The office also reported a 0.4 percent seasonally adjusted rise in the fourth quarter of 1996 from the third quarter.

Economists polled by Reuters had on average forecast 0.5 percent GDP growth in 1996's fourth quarter from the same year's third quarter, with the fourth quarter 3.1 percent up on the same 1995 period.
"The export figures are a bit deceptive as it is not industrial and agricultural exports but energy exports which have risen markedly," Nielsen said.

Nielsen said he was nonetheless encouraged by the growth in exports, expressing the hope that the economy in countries that were key Danish export markets, notably Germany, would return to more solid growth in 1997.
He also saw inventories being replenished and contributing positively to growth this year.
Economist Soeren Nielsen at Jyske Bank also welcomed the fourth quarter 1996 GDP figures in particular as showing higher growth than expected.

"The increase in growth is neatly distributed over the different demand components. Exports have done particularly well, although this should be seen in the context of weak exports in 1996's third quarter," he said.
Exports rose in 1996's fourth quarter by a seasonally adjusted 2.2 percent from the third quarter. --Soeren Linding Jakobsen, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
